verses.text: You are the children of the LORD your God. When someone dies, do not cut yourselves or shave the front of your heads.
For you are a people set apart as holy to the LORD your God. Out of all the peoples on the face of the earth, the LORD has chosen you to be his own special treasure.
Do not eat anything that is hateful to the LORD.
These are the animals you may eat: the ox, the sheep, the goat,
the deer, the gazelle, the roe deer, the wild goat, the ibex, the antelope, and the mountain sheep.
You may eat any animal that has a split hoof divided in two and that chews the cud.

But even among the animals that chew the cud or have a split hoof, you must not eat the camel, the hare, or the rock badger. They chew the cud but do not have a split hoof, so they are unclean for you.
The pig is also unclean for you. It has a split hoof but does not chew the cud. Do not eat their meat or touch their dead bodies.
Of all the creatures that live in the water, you may eat anything that has fins and scales.
But do not eat anything that does not have fins and scales. It is unclean for you.
You may eat any clean bird.
But these are the birds you must not eat: the eagle, the vulture, the osprey,
the red kite, the falcon, any kind of kite,
any kind of raven,
the ostrich, the owl, the seagull, any kind of hawk,
the little owl, the great owl, the horned owl,
the pelican, the vulture, the cormorant,
the stork, any kind of heron, the hoopoe, and the bat.
All flying insects are unclean for you. Do not eat them.
But you may eat any clean winged creature.

Do not eat anything you find already dead. You may give it to a foreigner living in your towns to eat, or you may sell it to a foreigner. But you are a people set apart as holy to the LORD your God. Do not cook a young goat in its mother's milk.
Every year be sure to set aside a tenth of all the crops your fields produce.

Eat this tenth of your grain, new wine, and olive oil, and the firstborn of your herds and flocks, in the presence of the LORD your God, at the place he will choose as the place where his name will live. Then you will learn to always fear the LORD your God.
But the LORD your God may bless you so much that the place he chooses for his name is too far away, and the journey too long, for you to carry your tenth there.
Then sell it for money. Take the money with you and go to the place the LORD your God will choose.
Use the money to buy whatever you want: cattle, sheep, wine, other strong drink, or anything you wish. Then you and your family will eat there in the presence of the LORD your God and be glad.
And do not forget the Levites living in your towns, because they have no share of land of their own.
At the end of every third year, bring the whole tenth of that year's crops and store it in your towns.

Then the Levites, who have no share of land of their own, the foreigners, the orphans, and the widows living in your towns may come and eat and be full. Then the LORD your God will bless you in all the work you do.
